verdict.rationale: Box documents natural-language interaction with content through the Box AI API (ask questions, summarize, extract). Its hosted MCP server lets AI agents search and use Box files, so an agent can operate Box on a user's behalf. There is no documented first-party natural-language command interface for operating the product itself, such as sharing, moving, or setting permissions by plain-language instruction. Missing for 10: documented natural-language commands for product actions (share/collaborate/organize), a first-party conversational command surface beyond content Q&A, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use the Box AI API to ask questions, extract metadata, and summarize files stored in Box.
It lets AI agents and apps search and use Box files over OAuth
Summarize, extract, generate, and query content with enterprise permissions intact.
Give AI agents access to Box content through the Box CLI or the Box MCP server.
